query:
DELETE FROM "Pin" p
        USING (
            SELECT pin.ctid AS pin_ctid
            FROM unnest($1::text[]) AS trashed(id)
            CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
                SELECT ctid
                FROM "Pin"
                WHERE "pinnedItemId" = trashed.id AND "pinnedItemType" = 'document'
                OFFSET 0
            ) pin
        ) found
        WHERE p.ctid = found.pin_ctid
